description: This Java source file defines a Spring service implementation 'SchedulerJobRunnerReadServiceImpl' that provides methods for retrieving job details and history, checking update permissions, and handling job-related database operations within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: SchedulerJobRunnerReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of SchedulerJobRunnerReadService, providing database access and logic for job details and history.

classes.name: JobHistoryMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation to map SQL query result set to JobDetailHistoryData objects.
